article.story: SAN LUIS OBISPO, Calif. -- — Hamad Mousa scored 18 points as Cal Poly beat Cal State-San Marcos 78-62 on Monday in the season opener for both teams. Mousa added seven rebounds for the Mustangs. Cayden Ward scored 15 points while going 6 for 10 from the field, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and added 11 rebounds and five assists. Guzman Vasilic had 13 points and went 4 for 8 from the field, including 3 for 6 from 3-point range. Wyatt Von Blanco led the way for the Cougars with 13 points and three steals. Cal State-San Marcos also got 10 points and two steals from Mikey Aikhionbare. Chris Carrillo finished with 10 points. Up next Cal Poly visits Arizona on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
